no_timeout.instructions: This code contains a direct call to a network API (such as fetch, http.request, axios, requests, or a database, RPC or socket client method) and that call has no time limit.

criteria.true: A network API call appears in this text, and nothing here bounds how long it may take (no timeout option, deadline, or abort signal that fires on a timer).
criteria.false: No network API call appears in this text (a call to a function defined in another file is not a network API call, even if that function makes a request), or every network call here has a timeout, a deadline, a timed abort signal, or goes through a client configured here with a timeout.
